basis: Published planning default: A$1,800/year for the original Model Y RWD repair fund. Older original Model Y: four-year/80,000-km basic cover can expire well before battery cover. Allow for paid suspension, thermal-system and electrical diagnosis as the car ages. Savings allowance, not an observed average repair bill. Rounded assumptions use age, cover and component costs. Excludes servicing, tyres and insured crashes. Claim warranty/recall remedies first. Full battery replacement is a separate stress case and can exceed this fund.

Older dual-motor Model Y: short basic cover, a second drive unit and potentially large thermal/electrical bills justify a larger cash buffer; this does not claim more frequent failures. Claim warranty/recall remedies first. Full battery replacement is a separate stress case and can exceed this fund.

Excludes servicing, tyres and insured crashes. Claim warranty/recall remedies first. Full battery replacement is a separate stress case and can exceed this fund.
